As a first-time sole trader with simple income, the **Self Assessment Simple** package at **£119 per tax year** would likely be the most suitable option for you. This package is designed for individuals with straightforward tax situations, making it a cost-effective choice for your needs.

If you have any specific questions about what the package includes or about the Self Assessment process, feel free to ask! You can also find more details on our [Self Assessment page](https://www.taxsimba.co.u

As a landlord needing to comply with Making Tax Digital (MTD), the lowest suitable Simbian plan is **Simbian Comply**, which costs **£29.99 per month (VAT included)**. This plan includes the necessary digital bookkeeping and quarterly updates required under MTD.

Just to clarify, you will need to use MTD if your qualifying income from property exceeds £30,000 in the 2025-26 tax year, starting from **6 April 2027**.
